rv.q: This captivating production of the evergreen musical is a fitting swansong from Pitlochry's outgoing artistic director, Elizabeth Newman
The Rodgers and Hammerstein classic marks a heart-warming end to Elizabeth Newman’s tenure as artistic director at Pitlochry Festival Theatre
This is Newman’s final show as Pitlochry’s artistic director before she moves on to run Sheffield Theatres, and she leaves on a high.
This is a triumphant production to close Newman’s time in Pitlochry, and as evidenced by the warm standing ovation it received, the audience clearly agrees.

Newman has invested Howard Lindsay and Russel Crouse's perfectly constructed adaptation of the real Maria Rainer's memoir with a freshness and a poignancy that makes for a moving and irresistible experience.
